facts.statement: One CP-8 controller is available Frostline-owned stock, already reserved for JOB-A; two coordinators request it for JOB-B and JOB-C. JOB-A owner Morgan has not agreed reallocation.

Another physically present controller belongs to customer Vale Ltd for its own job only. Cylinder CY-8 contains mixed contaminated recovered refrigerant, recorded evidence hold; no authorised assessment makes it reusable.
